name: zakat-calculator
description: Static, local-first zakat calculator: a zakat year from the day the wealth reaches the nisab, monthly gains, dated amounts, debts, zakat paid settling arrears first, a met / above / below verdict per year, a nisab price per year, and a graph. No backend, no build, nothing leaves the browser.

scripts.serve: node -e "const h=require('http'),f=require('fs'),p=require('path');h.createServer((q,s)=>{let u=decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]);if(u==='/')u='/index.html';const x=p.join(__dirname,u);f.readFile(x,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);return s.end('not found')}const m={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json','.svg':'image/svg+xml'}[p.extname(x)]||'application/octet-stream';s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m,'Cache-Control':'no-store'});s.end(d)})}).listen(8795,'127.0.0.1',()=>console.log('http://127.0.0.1:8795'))"
